author: serana_mobz
quote: Chugged along the first 10 hours, and god this game is dry as hell. The gameplay is basically Jason being a cuck/simp for Lucia. There's very little action unless you ignore the story, and the gameplay feels like it's being held back by the "relationship" the characters have. It keeps you waiting for the good part that never seems to come. I wouldn't recommend this at all, if you haven't played GTA 5 just go play that instead.
